ns2:course.label: Intro Tchg Elem Age Children
ns2:course.description: Examines the contexts of elementary education in the public schools. Includes content on teaching as a profession and community/family contexts of education. Coursework is integrated with field experiences with elementary children. 2 undergraduate hours. 2 graduate hours. Prerequisite: EPS 201; EPSY 236; admission to the Elementary Teacher Education Program.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 2 undergraduate hours. 2 graduate hours. Prerequisite: EPS 201; EPSY 236; admission to the Elementary Teacher Education Program.
